description: Reads construction pay applications — the AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment with its G703 Continuation Sheet, including Procore and Textura versions — and change orders, from PDF into structured JSON with arithmetic checks. Returns gross this period, retainage held and released, completed to date, contract sum, balance to finish and payment due for pay apps; for change orders, whether it is the subcontractor's request or the GC's executed change order, plus number, amount and date. $0.04 per page (up to 25 pages) in USDC per successful read via x402, quoted before you pay; failed reads are free.

document.description: The PDF, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is fine). Max about 3 MB and 25 pages.

subcontractor.description: Subcontractor company name — helps tell an RCO from a GC change order.

name: extract_document
title: Read an AIA G702/G703 pay application or a change order
